name: Galio
title: the Colossus

Q.name: Winds of War
Q.description: Galio fires two windblasts that deal 70/105/140/175/210 + 0.7×AP magic damage each. When the windblasts meet, they combine into a tornado that deals (85f4c0e9) × 4% max Health magic damage over 2 seconds.
Q.summary: Galio fires two windblasts that converge into a large tornado that deals damage over time.

W.name: Shield of Durand
W.description: Passive: Galio gains a 0.08/0.11/0.14/0.17/0.2×max HP Magic Shield after not taking damage for 12+ (by level) seconds. Begin Charging: Galio reduces incoming magic damage by (0.25/0.3/0.35/0.4/0.45 + APRatio×AP + 0.001×bonus MR + HPRatio×bonus max HP) × 1 and incoming physical damage by ((0.25/0.3/0.35/0.4/0.45 + APRatio×AP + 0.001×bonus MR + HPRatio×bonus max HP) × 1) × 0.5 and Slows himself by 15%. Release: Galio Taunts enemy champions for between 0.5 to 1.5 seconds, deals between 20/30/40/50/60 + 0.3×AP and (20/30/40/50/60 + 0.3×AP) × 3 magic damage, and refreshes the damage reduction for 2 seconds. Taunt duration, damage, and range increase with charge time.
W.summary: Galio charges a defensive stance, moving slowly. Upon releasing the charge, Galio will taunt and damage nearby enemies.

E.name: Justice Punch
E.description: Galio lunges forward with a mighty blow, Knocking Up for 0.75 seconds and dealing 100/135/170/205/240 + 1×AP magic damage to the first champion hit. Other enemies in the way take (100/135/170/205/240 + 1×AP) × 0.8 magic damage. Galio's dash stops on hitting terrain.
E.summary: Galio will briefly step back and charge, knocking up the first enemy champion he encounters.

R.name: Hero's Entrance
R.description: Galio designates an allied champion's position as his landing spot, granting all allied champions in the area Shield of Durand's passive Shield for 5 seconds. Galio then flies to his landing zone. When Galio lands, he Knocks Up for 0.75 seconds and deals 150/250/350 + 0.7×AP + 1×bonus MR magic damage.
R.summary: Galio designates an ally's position as his landing spot, granting all allies in the area a magic shield. After a delay Galio smashes down location, knocking up nearby enemies.

Passive.name: Colossal Smash
Passive.description: Every few seconds, Galio's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage in an area.
Passive.summary: Every few seconds, Galio's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage in an area.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Anti-mage tank who taunts with W, knocks up with E and joins fights across the map with R.
strengths: Strong against magic-damage lanes (W reduction, magic shield)
weaknesses: E can be stopped by champions (knocked back on hit)
profile.curveNote: Needs E to engage into W taunt.

Q.notes: Two windblasts; tornado if they meet

W.notes: Charge reduces damage (mostly magic); release taunts

E.notes: Dash; knocks up first champion; stops on champion collision

R.notes: Shield allies in area, then land and knock up

profile.windowAgainst: When W is down (no taunt / damage reduction) or after E.
